answer: Diverge-or-Die Challenge.** Each identity must periodically publish a fresh, agent-signed sonnet committing to a random nonce derived from a public horizon value, so any replay is detectable across the clone set. Clones sharing one key cannot answer divergent nonce challenges independently without breaking the mirror of their shared state, forcing self-inconsistency. An attacker must therefore provision a distinct signing process and independent state per identity, paying full compute and key-management cost per clone rather than duplicating one.
